question: How many buildings are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM buildings

question: How many readings are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM readings

question: Which buildings are classified as hostels?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM buildings WHERE type = 'hostel' ORDER BY name

question: When does the Annual tech fest start?
gold_sql: SELECT start_date FROM events WHERE name = 'Annual tech fest'

question: What is the date range covered by the readings?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(substr(reading_time,1,10)), MAX(substr(reading_time,1,10)) FROM readings

question: Which building has the greatest total electricity use over the whole period?
gold_sql: SELECT b.name FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY SUM(r.kwh) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which building has the lowest total electricity use over the whole period?
gold_sql: SELECT b.name FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY SUM(r.kwh) ASC LIMIT 1

question: Which hostel building used more electricity in total over the whole period?
gold_sql: SELECT b.name FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id WHERE b.type = 'hostel' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY SUM(r.kwh) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the CS Lab Block's average hourly electricity use for hours 0 through 4 inclusive (00:00 to 04:00) over the whole period? Report the result to two decimal places.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.kwh),2) FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id WHERE b.name = 'CS Lab Block' AND CAST(substr(r.reading_time,12,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 4

question: Which building type had the greatest total electricity use over the whole period?
gold_sql: SELECT b.type FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id GROUP BY b.type ORDER BY SUM(r.kwh) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which building had the highest total electricity use on weekdays during hours 8 through 17 inclusive (08:00 to 17:00)?
gold_sql: SELECT b.name FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id WHERE strftime('%w', r.reading_time) NOT IN ('0','6') AND CAST(substr(r.reading_time,12,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 8 AND 17 GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY SUM(r.kwh) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which date had the highest total electricity use across campus?
gold_sql: SELECT substr(reading_time,1,10) AS day FROM readings GROUP BY day ORDER BY SUM(kwh) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What were the Library's average hourly electricity use values for hours 18 through 23 and 0 through 2, inclusive, during the Mid-semester exams dates and on all other dates? Report both values rounded to one decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN substr(r.reading_time,1,10) BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date THEN r.kwh END),1) AS exam_avg, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN substr(r.reading_time,1,10) NOT BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date THEN r.kwh END),1) AS other_avg FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id CROSS JOIN events e WHERE b.name = 'Library' AND e.name = 'Mid-semester exams' AND (CAST(substr(r.reading_time,12,2) AS INTEGER) >= 18 OR CAST(substr(r.reading_time,12,2) AS INTEGER) <= 2)

question: Which building had the highest average hourly electricity use on the Annual tech fest dates?
gold_sql: SELECT b.name FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id JOIN events e ON e.name = 'Annual tech fest' AND substr(r.reading_time,1,10) BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY AVG(r.kwh) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What were the Main Academic Block's average hourly electricity use values on weekdays and weekends? Report the weekday value first, then the weekend value, rounded to one decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN strftime('%w',r.reading_time) NOT IN ('0','6') THEN r.kwh END),1) AS weekday_avg, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN strftime('%w',r.reading_time) IN ('0','6') THEN r.kwh END),1) AS weekend_avg FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id WHERE b.name = 'Main Academic Block'

question: Which building had the largest increase in average hourly electricity use during the Annual tech fest dates compared with all other dates?
gold_sql: SELECT b.name FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id CROSS JOIN events e WHERE e.name = 'Annual tech fest' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN substr(r.reading_time,1,10) BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date THEN r.kwh END) - AVG(CASE WHEN substr(r.reading_time,1,10) NOT BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date THEN r.kwh END) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What were the Admin Block's average hourly electricity use values on weekdays and weekends? Report the weekday value first, then the weekend value, rounded to one decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN strftime('%w',r.reading_time) NOT IN ('0','6') THEN r.kwh END),1) AS weekday_avg, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN strftime('%w',r.reading_time) IN ('0','6') THEN r.kwh END),1) AS weekend_avg FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id WHERE b.name = 'Admin Block'

question: List every date in the readings data, in chronological order, with the campus total for that date.
gold_sql: SELECT substr(reading_time,1,10) AS day, ROUND(SUM(kwh),2) AS campus_total FROM readings GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

question: How much higher was the Library's average hourly electricity use for 00:00 to 02:00 during the Mid-semester exams dates than on other dates? Report the exam average, other-date average, and difference, rounded to one decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN substr(r.reading_time,1,10) BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date THEN r.kwh END),1) AS exam_avg, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN substr(r.reading_time,1,10) NOT BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date THEN r.kwh END),1) AS other_avg, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN substr(r.reading_time,1,10) BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date THEN r.kwh END) - AVG(CASE WHEN substr(r.reading_time,1,10) NOT BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date THEN r.kwh END),1) AS difference FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id CROSS JOIN events e WHERE b.name = 'Library' AND e.name = 'Mid-semester exams' AND CAST(substr(r.reading_time,12,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 2

question: Does the CS Lab Block use as much electricity at night as during the day? Compare average hourly use for hours 0 through 4 inclusive with hours 8 through 17 inclusive, reporting the night value first and the daytime value second, rounded to one decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(substr(r.reading_time,12,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 4 THEN r.kwh END),1) AS night_avg, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(substr(r.reading_time,12,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 8 AND 17 THEN r.kwh END),1) AS daytime_avg FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id WHERE b.name = 'CS Lab Block'

question: How much electricity did the CS Lab Blok use in total over the whole period?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.kwh),1) FROM readings r JOIN buildings b ON b.id = r.building_id WHERE b.name = 'CS Lab Block'

question: At what hour of the day was the campus-wide average total electricity use per hour highest? Report the hour and average campus total, rounded to one decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT substr(reading_time,12,2) AS hour, ROUND(AVG(hourly_total),1) AS avg_campus_total FROM (SELECT reading_time, SUM(kwh) AS hourly_total FROM readings GROUP BY reading_time) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY AVG(hourly_total) DESC LIMIT 1
